data.name: Pacific Terrace Hotel
data.hotelDescription:
Beachfront Luxury at Pacific Terrace Hotel

Beachfront Bliss: Enjoy a beachfront outdoor pool, hot tub, and stunning ocean views in our island-inspired rooms.

Luxurious Amenities: Indulge in terrycloth bathrobes, elegant dark wood furnishings, and tasteful tropical linens for a truly luxurious stay.

Convenience at Your Fingertips: Take advantage of concierge services, charge back to the room options, gated underground parking, and a modern fitness center.

Experience the best of San Diego at Pacific Terrace Hotel. Book your stay now for a memorable beachfront getaway.
